# Test different framework generation options
# Verifies that various command-line options work correctly

env INPUT_DIR=$HOME/.appledocs/cache/developer.apple.com/tutorials/data/documentation

# Test: Generate Foundation framework
mkdir foundation_output
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework Foundation -input $INPUT_DIR -output foundation_output
exists foundation_output/foundation/functions.gen.go
exists foundation_output/foundation/types.gen.go
grep 'package foundation' foundation_output/foundation/functions.gen.go

# Test: Output directory for CoreGraphics
mkdir purego_output
exec generate-framework-bindings -framework CoreGraphics -input $INPUT_DIR -output purego_output
exists purego_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
grep 'package coregraphics' purego_output/coregraphics/functions.gen.go
